headline: Keravnos: 15% tax on multinationals is mandatory – No companies leaving Cyprus due to Pillar 2
summary: Finance official Keravnos said the 15% tax on multinationals is mandatory and that no American multinationals are leaving Cyprus due to Pillar 2. The legislation is being revised to implement it.
why: Pillar 2 is the OECD global minimum tax of 15% on large multinational groups, which affects where companies book profits and how they are taxed.
